s: He paid off the debt in full.
def: Money that is owed to someone.

s: Keep the receipt in case you return it.
def: A paper showing what you paid.

s: The cereal is in the third aisle.
def: A walkway between rows of shelves or seats.

s: She ran a campaign for class president.
def: An organized effort to reach a goal.

s: He is studying a foreign language.
The grand jury voted to indict the suspect.
def: To formally charge with a crime.

s: A white yacht sailed past the harbor.
def: A large boat used for pleasure trips.

s: The leaves change color in autumn.
def: The season between summer and winter.

s: Her graduation was a joyful occasion.
Please respond immediately.
I recommend reading that book.
def: To suggest as good or worthwhile.

s: The teacher gave a short assessment.
The project is due tomorrow.
I appreciate all your help.
The team played an aggressive game.
The two lists correspond exactly.
def: To match, or to write letters back and forth.

s: The plan met strong opposition.
She won the spelling competition.
Saying it took forever was an exaggeration.
def: A statement that makes something seem bigger than it is.

s: The revolution changed the country's government.
def: A complete change, often of a government.

s: Her observation about the graph was sharp.
The illustration helped explain the text.
def: A picture that explains or decorates.

s: Salt water speeds up corrosion of metal.
def: The slow wearing away of metal.

s: The omission of his name was an accident.
We anticipate a large crowd.
def: To expect something ahead of time.

s: The museum features contemporary art.
The old paper began to disintegrate.
Try to see it from her perspective.
A subordinate clause cannot stand alone.
The caterpillar's transformation amazed us.
They made considerable progress.
The date has great significance.
The colony declared its independence.
He is a reliable teammate.
def: Able to be trusted or counted on.

s: Her persistence finally paid off.
It was a courageous decision.
The new system improved efficiency.
Finishing the race was a real achievement.
Can you perceive the faint sound?
def: To become aware of through the senses.

s: We have sufficient supplies.
The eagle will seize the fish.
He reads during his leisure time.
Please accept this gift.
Everyone came except Marcus.
The medicine had a strong effect.
def: A result. Usually a noun, unlike 'affect'.

s: She gave me good advice.
def: A suggestion. The noun; 'advise' is the verb.

s: I advise you to start early.
def: To give advice. The verb; 'advice' is the noun.

s: Try not to lose your keys.
def: To misplace or be defeated. Not 'loose'.

s: The bureaucrat reviewed every form.
def: An official who works in a complex system of rules.

s: She wants to study psychology.
def: The study of the mind and behavior.

s: His speech was full of clever rhetoric.
def: The art of persuasive speaking or writing.

s: A mnemonic can help you remember the order.
def: A trick that helps you remember something.

s: A deep chasm split the canyon floor.
def: A deep crack in the earth.

s: The author wrote under a pseudonym.
def: A false name used by a writer.

s: The bus left from the downtown depot.
The court issued a subpoena for the records.
def: An order to appear in court or produce evidence.

s: She is committed to finishing the project.
Each student filled out a questionnaire.
He blushed with embarrassment.
def: The feeling of being ashamed or awkward.

s: The school arranged an accommodation for the test.
def: An adjustment made to help someone.

s: The instructions were unnecessarily long.
def: In a way that was not needed.

s: Find the area of the parallelogram.
def: A four-sided shape with opposite sides parallel.

s: The wire is one millimeter thick.
Leaving the gate open was irresponsible.
def: Not showing good judgment or care.

s: The library announced the acquisition of rare maps.
She had a suspicion the cat took the yarn.
def: A feeling something may be true without proof.

s: The reading comprehension test had ten passages.
The pronunciation of that word is tricky.
def: The way a word is spoken.

s: The case fell outside the court's jurisdiction.
def: The area where an authority has power.

s: It took gentle persuasion to change his mind.
Measure every dimension of the prism.
def: A measurement such as length or width.

s: The drawing was made with great precision.
Under no circumstance should you skip it.
The storm caused unprecedented damage.
The species are interdependent.
The museum held a retrospective of her work.
The antagonist opposes the hero.
def: A character who works against the main character.

s: The route was predetermined.
The cut was superficial and healed fast.
def: On the surface only; not deep.

s: They rode the transcontinental railroad.
He is a conscientious student who checks his work.
def: Careful and thorough in doing what is right.

s: A good dictionary is indispensable.
Her perseverance impressed the coach.
The proposal proved controversial.
Change was inevitable.
The team showed real resilience.
def: The ability to recover from difficulty.

s: The bank spotted the counterfeit bill.
def: A fake copy made to fool people.

s: The nation became a sovereign state.
A vitamin deficiency can cause fatigue.
He was the heir to the family farm.
def: A person who inherits property. Sounds like 'air'.

s: The team had to forfeit the game.
def: To lose or give up something as a penalty.

s: Beans are a good source of protein.
def: A nutrient the body needs to grow.

s: The two angles are complementary.
She bought stationery to write letters.
The data came in discrete groups.
The poem makes an allusion to a Greek myth.
The question will elicit a thoughtful answer.
def: To draw out a response. Not 'illicit'.

s: The ruling set a legal precedent.
def: An earlier case used as an example. Not 'president'.
